acceptance: Policy data states what evolve code does when the gotypes index is absent or stale for a callers or api query: refuse with a typed reason, or route to the next backend, as one rule with one home.
The spec (no failover) and the plan (fall to trail) agree after the change, and a test pins the chosen rule.
fix: Decide and encode the fallthrough rule for an absent gotypes index as routing data, and reconcile the spec and the plan.
summary: Making gotypes the default for callers and api (item G4) needs a rule for an absent or stale gotypes index. The code-index spec says no failover, while the plan says fall to trail. The dossier marks the default switch as depending on this decision.
title: Routing data decides what callers and api do when the gotypes index is absent
